idea-plugin.name: Frost
idea-plugin.description:
Translucent, blurred IDE windows - frosted glass for your IDE. A transparent background with real blur, without a background image.

  • The whole UI is translucent: main window, editor, tool windows, terminal, toolbars, status bar, popups, tooltips, notifications and dialogs.
  • Real window blur (frosted glass, acrylic-like) rendered by the macOS compositor, so it stays light on resources.
  • The IDE paints exactly as designed: only the theme's background colours turn to glass, applied to the finished pixels of each window. Text, icons, selection, file colours and search results stay as they are, and other plugins' UI gets the same glass.
  • Light and dark themes, including switching theme while the IDE is running.
  • Live preview sliders: UI opacity, floating windows opacity, blur radius and floating windows blur radius; Fast or Exact rendering; Reset to Defaults.

Settings: Settings | Appearance & Behavior | Frost. Quick toggle: View | Frost.

macOS only for now - on Windows and Linux the plugin does nothing.

Early access: tested on macOS with IntelliJ IDEA 2026.2; other JetBrains IDEs 2026.2+ (PyCharm, WebStorm, PhpStorm, GoLand...) should work too. Something looks off or stays solid? Please report it on GitHub Issues.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
0.2.0

  • New engine: the glass is applied by macOS to the finished pixels of each window, the IDE itself paints unchanged. It replaces the colour swapping behind menu items staying dark after hovering, the dark spot in password fields, black cells in database tables and doubled selection highlights.
  • Rendering setting: Fast (default, Core Animation colour matrix) or Exact (Core Image colour table).
  • Simpler settings: UI opacity for the main window, floating windows opacity for popups and dialogs, and the two blur radii. The editor, sticky lines and highlight sliders are gone: the editor follows UI opacity, and highlights stay as the theme paints them.
  • Restores, once, the IDE animations and caches that Frost 0.1.x switched off and the IDE then kept off (registry: ide.experimental.ui.animations, editor.zero.latency.rendering.double.buffering, editor.skeleton.animation.enabled, database.grid.render.cache, database.grid.render.cache.fast.scroll).

0.1.1

  • Fixed black UI after switching projects in the same window.

0.1.0 - first public release (early access).

  • Translucent, blurred main window, popups and dialogs on macOS.
  • Separate opacity and blur for floating windows; editor, sticky lines and highlight opacity.
  • Live preview of every setting.
